caseName: Wabaningo Boy Scout Camp v. Michigan Tax Commission
caseNameFull: WABANINGO BOY SCOUT CAMP v. MICHIGAN TAX COMMISSION
attorneys: Amos M. Mathews and Alban Weber for appellant in each case., Frank J. Kelley, Attorney General of Michigan, Robert A. Derengoski, Solicitor General, and T. Carl Holbrook and William D. Dexter, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee in both cases.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeals are dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
